defects.summary: The quote cache is still keyed by (sku, qty), so after quoting in EUR the same sku/qty in USD (or PLN) returns the cached EUR amount, and the first currency asked wins.

_convert catches KeyError/OSError from the rate lookup and returns the unconverted USD amount; the task requires RateUnavailable, so an outage silently yields a quote in the wrong currency (RateUnavailable is never raised).
summarize() has unknown: list[str] = [] as its default and appends to it, so unknown SKUs of earlier calls leak into the Summary of later calls that did not pass a list.

decoys.summary: USD is returned before any rate lookup: USD is the base currency, so no rate is needed (the task says so).
The bulk discount applies from exactly 10 units (>=, as in the base tests) and the quantity is rounded with Decimal half-even; unchanged, correct code the diff only moves the conversion after.
